name: Reincarnation
overview: The Scriptures clearly affirm the finality of death, emphasizing that once a person dies, they do not return to life in this world. Verses from Job highlight that when a man goes to the grave, he comes up no more and enters a land of darkness from which there is no return. Similarly, Psalm 78 describes human life as fleeting like a passing wind that does not come again. These passages collectively refute the idea of reincarnation, underscoring that death is a definitive departure rather than a cyclical return to earthly existence.
